lessonGrammar.name: 目的状语从句 so that
lessonGrammar.note: so that 引导目的状语从句,表示"以便、为了",从句中常用情态动词 may/can。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Before the interview, I ask my former teacher to rehearse every possible scenario with me, so that no unexpected question may agitate me.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 面试之前,我请以前的老师和我一起排练每一种可能出现的情景,这样任何意料之外的问题都不会让我焦虑。

lessonGrammar.name: 不定式作宾补 ask sb to do
lessonGrammar.note: ask sb to do sth:动词 ask 后接"宾语+不定式",不定式作宾语补足语。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Before the interview, I ask my former teacher to rehearse every possible scenario with me, so that no unexpected question may agitate me.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 面试之前,我请以前的老师和我一起排练每一种可能出现的情景,这样任何意料之外的问题都不会让我焦虑。

lessonGrammar.name: 长难句拆解
lessonGrammar.note: 拆解长句第一步:先找主干 I ask my former teacher,再依次挂上状语、从句等修饰成分。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Before the interview, I ask my former teacher to rehearse every possible scenario with me, so that no unexpected question may agitate me.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 面试之前,我请以前的老师和我一起排练每一种可能出现的情景,这样任何意料之外的问题都不会让我焦虑。

lessonGrammar.name: 从句嵌套
lessonGrammar.note: 宾语从句 that my tension may escalate 内部又套着时间状语从句 as we approach the date,是典型的多层嵌套长句,拆解时应逐层剥开。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: When I recollect the process of preparation, I still feel that my tension may escalate as we approach the date, yet the discipline that I build is my most precious legacy.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 当我回忆备考的过程时,我仍然觉得,随着日期临近,我的紧张感会加剧,然而我建立的纪律是最珍贵的遗产。

lessonGrammar.name: 时间状语从句 when/as
lessonGrammar.note: when 与 as 都可引导时间状语从句;as 强调"随着"的渐进过程。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: When I recollect the process of preparation, I still feel that my tension may escalate as we approach the date, yet the discipline that I build is my most precious legacy.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 当我回忆备考的过程时,我仍然觉得,随着日期临近,我的紧张感会加剧,然而我建立的纪律是最珍贵的遗产。
